subject: Post-call recap & proposed buy-cycle roadmap for Zenith AI
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zenith.ai>, Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@zenith.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed buy-cycle roadmap (Zenith AI)

Hi Samir / Laura — thanks again for the time today. Wanted to capture the key points and next steps so we have a mutual plan to drive this forward. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of pain & goals you shared
- Production latency spikes on burst traffic (affects user search experience). Current 95th/99th p95/p99 for inference is ~600ms / ~1.2s for critical routes.
- Token cost is a major concern: target is ~40% reduction on current per-token spend for embeddings + generation.
- Regulatory constraint: pilot must run in a private VPC and avoid sending PHI to public endpoints — security review required.
- Decision criteria: performance (p99 < 250–300ms on critical routes), cost per 1M tokens, and evidence of SOC2 + audit logs for requests.

Proposed milestones (dates are suggested, flexible on your end):
1) Pilot kickoff & access provision — May 25 (2-week pilot)
2) Pilot evaluation (metrics collection + cost report) — Jun 8
3) Security & procurement review complete — target Jun 15
4) Exec decision & contracting — Jun 30

Primary stakeholders we captured today
- Technical: Samir Patel (AI Platform Lead),
- Procurement: Laura Gomez (Procurement Lead, handles SOW/PO),
- Security reviewer: CISO team (we agreed you'll share the contact),
- Redwood: Dylan Brooks (AE, pilot + commercial lead), Evelyn Hart (Customer Success, onboarding)

Immediate asks / next steps we agreed
- Samir: confirm pilot scope (routes & dataset subset) and that May 25 works for provisioning.
- Laura: confirm procurement timeline and whether a standard PO or SOW + PO is preferred.
- Redwood: I’ll send a short mutual action plan (attachment) and links to SOC2/whitepaper. I’ll also prepare a dedicated capacity quote and SOW draft for your review.

Attachments: zenith_milestones_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood-capabilities-onepager.pdf

If that lines up, I’ll lock in the May 25 pilot window and send calendar invites + onboarding checklist.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zenith.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@zenith.ai>, procurement@zenith.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed buy-cycle roadmap (Zenith AI)

Thanks Dylan — this is great and matches our notes. A few adjustments and confirmations from our side: 

1) Pilot scope: we want the pilot to cover the search inference route + the internal content-summarization batch job. That should give coverage across low-latency and batched workloads.
2) May 25 pilot kickoff looks good on our calendar. Can your team provision a private VPC endpoint and a test AWS region (us-east-1)? We will share a scrubbed dataset by May 22.
3) Security: our info-sec will need SOC2 Type II evidence and request logs showing requester identity + request/response metadata for a 30-day window. Can you provide SOC2 and an evidence checklist?
4) Procurement & decision process: Laura and I expect procurement review complete by Jun 15. Exec sign-off expected Jun 30 (depending on pilot outcomes). If pilot shows performance + cost improvements, procurement can escalate for faster approval.

Attachments / asks from Redwood: please attach the SOW draft and a simple onboarding checklist (hardware/regions, IAM roles, expected sample payloads). Also include the trial access steps and a contact for onboarding (who will own the pilot from your side).

I’ll loop our CISO when we have the SOC2 package.

Samir
Samir Patel
AI Platform Lead, Zenith AI
samir.patel@zenith.ai
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Zenith pilot — pilot scope, SOC2, and quote needed

Rishi / Evelyn — looping you in after the discovery with Zenith. Key asks below; please advise on owners and ETA.

What Zenith needs (high priority)
- Private VPC endpoint + provisioning in us-east-1 for May 25 pilot.
- SOC2 Type II evidence + a short evidence checklist for their info-sec. We should include retention and request-log capabilities. Link to SOC2 in thread when ready.
- Dedicated capacity quote: they want to understand committed GPU capacity vs burst pricing; they’re targeting ~40% token cost reduction. Can infra pricing provide a 3-month pilot quote + projected monthly cost at scale?
- SOW draft: attach SOW-draft-zenith.pdf (I’m preparing the first pass but would like legal/commercial eyes).

Proposed owner assignments
- Evelyn: onboarding lead for the pilot (customer success) — can you confirm availability May 25–Jun 8?
- Rishi: help finalize dedicated capacity quote and confirm whether we can guarantee the latency p99 target for the proposed pilot config.

I’ll update the MAP and send to Zenith with the requested attachments once we have the SOC2 link and the capacity numbers.

Thanks —
Dylan
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@zenith.ai>, Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@zenith.ai>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, procurement@zenith.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 02:10:00 +0000
Subject: Updated MAP, SOW draft, SOC2 link & next steps (Zenith pilot)

Hi Samir / Laura — appreciate the quick confirmation. Attaching an updated mutual action plan and the SOW draft per Samir’s asks. I’ve also included links below for SOC2 and our onboarding checklist.

What we’ve attached/linked
- Attachment: zenith_milestones_v1.xlsx (updated with confirmed dates + owners)
- Attachment: SOW-draft-zenith.pdf (first pass — legal to review)
- SOC2 evidence: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-type2-report-2025 (read-only link for your security team)
- Onboarding checklist & pilot playbook: https://drive.google.com/zenith-pilot-onboarding
- DocuSign (SOW): https://docusign.com/s/zenith-sow-2026 (we can collect signature once SOW is finalized)

Confirmed timeline (finalized)
- May 22: Zenith provides scrubbed dataset and security contact info
- May 25: Pilot provisioning & handoff to CS (Evelyn)
- Jun 8: Pilot wrap / metrics collection (cost + perf)
- Jun 15: Security & procurement sign-off expected
- Jun 30: Exec decision / contract signature target

Immediate next steps (this week)
1) Laura — confirm preferred contracting route (SOW + PO or standard PO).
2) Samir — share the scrubbed dataset by May 22 and security contact to receive SOC2 link.
3) Evelyn — confirm you can lead May 25 kickoff and provide an onboarding resource for the pilot.
4) Rishi / Infra — deliver dedicated capacity number and projected cost for the pilot by EOD Thu (May 21).

If all good, I’ll send calendar invites for the May 25 kickoff and the pilot metrics review on Jun 8. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: zenith_milestones_v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-zenith.pdf
